en_before: Many people confuse a capsule wardrobe with minimalist style. A capsule is a method for organizing and choosing clothes; Minimalism is a visual aesthetic. You can build a beige, white and gray Clean Girl capsule, but you can also build one around black, silver, leather, lace and dark denim for Dark Feminine or Goth.
